about: What the app tells users about each site and program, from the quality check (dev/quality_check.py), each line reviewed. Every user's app reads this file from GitHub (teleloadzai/signs.py). 'why' is the evidence: never shown to users.

instagram|gallery-dl.why: "HTTP redirect to login page" on a public reel; yt-dlp got the same reel (audit 2026-09-26).

tiktok|tiktokdownloader.why: "Forbidden" with NO cookies (audit); in the app, 2026-09-26, the whole video (26,964,923 bytes) with 9 visit cookies and no sid_tt / sessionid.

kuaishou|ks-downloader.why: "Failed to retrieve posts data" with no cookies; worked with the user's QR log-in 2026-09-23.

douyin|tiktokdownloader.why: "Failed to retrieve data!" with 2 visit cookies (ttwid, __ac_nonce); the user's 4 downloads of 2026-09-26 worked with 35 cookies from one visit and NO sessionid.

vimeo|yt-dlp.why: "Use --username and --password ... (vimeo) to provide account credentials", on 2 links of 2. Never tried with a log-in.

reddit|yt-dlp.why: "Account authentication is required. Use --cookies-from-browser or --cookies", 4 public links of 4, no cookies AND a visit's (yt-dlp 2026.11.04.232659, quality check 2026-11-15). Worked with no log-in on 2026-09-26.

tiktok|tiktokdownloader.why: 9 visit cookies, no sid_tt, the whole video (CLAUDE.md §4).

douyin|tiktokdownloader.why: 35 visit cookies and no sessionid: the user's 4 downloads worked (§4).

instagram|gallery-dl.why: gallery-dl: "redirect to login page" with no log-in (the audit, §4).

kuaishou|ks-downloader.why: KS-Downloader: "Failed to retrieve posts data"; worked with a log-in.

bilibili|yt-dlp.why: "Unable to extract initial state" without a log-in on 2026-10-24; on 2026-11-09 (2026.11.04) 11 of 12 qualities came whole with NO cookies.

bilibili|yutto.why: yutto 2.3.1 with no cookies: a whole 480p video (1080p needs the log-in, said on the card: runners.TOP_WITHOUT_LOGIN).

reddit|yt-dlp.why: Quality check 2026-11-15, reviewed by the user: yt-dlp asked for an account on every public link, with no cookies and with a visit's ("Account authentication is required"). Worked with none on 2026-09-26.

vimeo|yt-dlp.why: Quality check 2026-11-15, reviewed by the user: yt-dlp asked for an account ("only works when logged-in").

bilibili|yt-dlp.text: Bilibili keeps “1080p high bitrate” for its premium members: a normal log-in did not unlock it.
bilibili|yt-dlp.why: BV1Gsnj6XE9M: "Format(s) 1080P 高码率 are missing; you have to become a premium member", with no cookies AND a non-premium log-in; 360p to 1080p came either way. yutto: not checked.

BV1Gsnj6XE9M: Bilibili's main server cuts the AV1 1080p file (100026), 5.2 MB of 23.6 MB, on 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-16; the H.264 1080p (30080) came whole both times (88.6 MB, ffprobe 1080p, 257 s). 3 other videos' AV1 1080p came whole; AV1 720p whole, so only 1080p. Not tied to a yt-dlp version.

rumble|yt-dlp.next: Rumble refused it (403). It may work again after an update.
rumble|yt-dlp.why: Both test links, with and without cookies: "HTTP Error 403: Forbidden" (RumbleEmbed), 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-16 (yt-dlp 2026.11.14.232655).
